answer: An ocean cleanup market escrows each garden or copper survey payout and requires a bond B per report. Unpredictable audits check reports against external evidence. Proven fabrications lose the bond; abandoning a key cannot free its escrow. If an unaudited fake earns at most G and audit probability is p, set B so pB > (1-p)G. Thus n fake aliases multiply expected losses instead of escaping liability. Extra honest agents may earn by doing real work. This needs sound evidence and audits that colluding reporters cannot predict or bribe.
